judge.reason: The answer rejects the three-branch cap with the given evidence (12 branches under four hours old, 8-minute CI, rare conflicts), proposes local signals for branch age, time to green main, and CI/queue time, and keeps protections in place (required checks, no force-push, reviews) without forcing a migration. It never addresses release obligations such as release or maintenance branches, which the rubric lists as a required assessment dimension, so the assessment is incomplete.
